description: Routing eval for the verification seam introduced by the verification-engineer agent (ROLE-004). verification-engineer, sde-fullstack, code-reviewer, and root-cause all answer to check/test/verify/confirm vocabulary. The boundaries: verification-engineer independently EXECUTES checks against explicit criteria and returns a pass/fail/inconclusive verdict; sde-fullstack implements (and self-verifies) changes; code-reviewer judges a diff WITHOUT running it; root-cause diagnoses WHY an observed failure happens. Positives name the intended member; negatives share the verify/check vocabulary but must route to none of them.
notes: Seeded 2026-07-29 with ROLE-004; baseline captured the same day (baselines/history/2026-07-29-verification-round.md, opus @ 420s): all three negatives 0% across runs, with two decoys routing to the correct NON-members (neg-lab-verify fired lab-audit, neg-ci-verification-step fired ci-actions) — the seam does not leak inward and the decoys land where they belong. All five positives 0%: the agent positives match the documented headless under-fire signature, and pos-diagnose-why is the first SKILL positive observed at 0% — its vocabulary is deliberately non-sharp ('figure out what's causing it', never 'root cause') while the same batch proves sharp-vocabulary skills fire; treat it as a comparison candidate for EVAL-003's isolation probe, not as a case to tune. The suite caveat binds hard here: three of the four members are AGENTS, whose positives under-fire in headless one-shot mode — trust the negatives and cross-run regressions over absolute agent-positive rates. Tightest seams: 'verify the fix' (verification-engineer) vs 'fix it and add a test' (sde-fullstack); 'read the diff, don't run it' (code-reviewer) vs 'run it and report' (verification-engineer); 'is it actually fixed' (verification-engineer) vs 'why is it failing' (root-cause). Negatives rely on the documented whole-cluster default for expect_not_fires; no deliberate narrowing exists in this cluster.

cases.prompt: Our nightly sync job started timing out three days ago and nobody knows why. Figure out what's causing it.
cases.expected_output: An observed failure whose CAUSE is unknown — root-cause's loop, not a verification pass. 'Figure out what's causing it' separates diagnosis from 'tell me whether it works'.

cases.prompt: After last night's power blip, verify all the services in my lab came back up and are healthy.
cases.expected_output: Live-lab health, not repository verification — homelab-engineer (with lab-audit for hygiene) owns this, and neither is a member. 'Verify' is the decoy vocabulary.

cases.prompt: Add a verification stage to our GitHub Actions pipeline that runs the acceptance suite on every PR.
cases.expected_output: CI pipeline authoring — the ci-actions skill's remit, not a one-time verification. 'Verification stage' and 'acceptance suite' are the decoy vocabulary; the deliverable is workflow YAML.

cases.prompt: Verify whether Postgres 16 still supports the recovery.conf file before we design our backup tooling around it.
cases.expected_output: An evidence question answered from sources — researcher's remit, not test execution. 'Verify whether X supports Y' is research; there is nothing to run and no acceptance criteria to grade.
